title: Find a mixture temperature
statement:
In an insulated cup, 40.0 g of water at 80.0 °C mixes with 120.0 g of water at 20.0 °C. Neglect cup heat. What is the final temperature?

[_]{a}

explanations: This assigns the larger mass to the hotter water.
This subtracts temperatures without an energy balance.

hints: Both samples have the same specific heat.
Use zero net heat in the insulated cup.
The result should be closer to 20 °C.
solution: Cancel the common specific heat in $40.0(T_f-80.0)+120.0(T_f-20.0)=0$. This gives $35.0^\circ$C.
